⭐ The 6 wow moments

💳 ZainCash Payment
Iraq's dominant mobile wallet included at checkout. Signals this app was genuinely built for the Iraqi market, not just translated.
📍 Live GPS Tracking
Real Baghdad map, moving van, ETA countdown. "The customer always knows exactly where their worker is."
🏅 Pre-Hire Profiles
See Sara M.'s photo, nationality, 6 years experience, Gold tier, 820 orders — before confirming. Builds trust before the door opens.
🤳 Arrival Selfie
Worker selfie at the door → instantly on the customer screen. Eliminates "did she arrive?" and builds accountability from minute one.
📸 Before / After Photos
Side-by-side proof of work sent to the customer automatically. No other home services app in Iraq does this.
⭐ TAP Credits
Every booking earns points. Confirmed screen shows +80 pts instantly. The loyalty loop that keeps customers coming back.

💡 Tips while exploring

🌐
Switch language anytime

Tap "العربية 🌐" or "English 🌐" in the top-left corner. The entire app — all text, layout direction, and labels — switches instantly.

🔔
Watch for push notifications

Two pop up automatically: an AC upsell offer at 5 seconds, and a post-job rating prompt at 12 seconds. Let them appear — they demo the smart nudge system.

📶
Works fully offline

No internet required after the file loads. The map tiles need a connection, but every screen, button, and flow works without Wi-Fi.

↩️
Going back

Use the ← back arrow in the top-right of each screen. The Home button in the bottom nav always returns to the main dashboard.

⚡
This is a demo, not the final product

Some taps show a brief toast message instead of a full screen — that's normal. Every real feature will be fully built in the final app.
